apis.purpose: Validate local folder path and count top-level PDF/DOCX files

request.folderPath: string absolute or relative local path

apis.purpose: Start screening run with folder path plus active criteria, returns run id
Poll run progress and final summary plus per-resume rows
Freeze chunked queue between chunks of 10
Stop remaining files, finalize partial output plus report for processed files

components.name: Web UI static pages
components.responsibility: Folder input plus criteria chips, chunked progress with pause/cancel, results summary plus per-resume table. Plain static JS served by backend, no build step.

components.name: Screening REST API
components.responsibility: Folder scan, run lifecycle (start/status/pause/resume/cancel), input validation, serves frontend static files.

components.name: Chunked run orchestrator
components.responsibility: In-memory run registry, processes files in chunks of 10, supports pause/cancel, aggregates counts, triggers output writer at end or on cancel.

components.name: Resume text extractor and analyzer
components.responsibility: Extract text from text-based PDF/DOCX, estimate total years experience via date-range regex, detect skills, fuzzy case-insensitive keyword match ignoring case/spacing/punctuation plus alias map.

components.name: Qualification engine
components.responsibility: Pluggable criterion evaluators with AND logic. Emits Qualified/Not Qualified/Undetermined plus per-criterion status and human-readable reason. Unknown experience maps to Undetermined, never silent reject.

components.name: Output folder plus Excel report writer
components.responsibility: Create resume-screening-output-<Jalali YYYY-MM-DD> with -1/-2 collision suffix inside source folder, copy only Qualified files byte-identical, write single-sheet xlsx with summary block plus per-resume rows.

dataFlow.description: User enters path and criteria, polls run status
API delegates chunk execution and state
Parsed facts evaluated against active criteria
Final or partial results written to disk
dataFlow.via: ResumeResult list at finish or cancel

fields.name: keywords
fields.note: deduped, blank entries rejected client and server side

fields.name: candidateName
fields.note: best-effort first non-empty heading line, else empty

decisions.decision: Python 3.11 + FastAPI backend serving plain HTML/JS, no frontend framework, no database
decisions.rationale: Python has mature offline PDF/DOCX/Excel/Jalali libs, zero build step, single pip install runs on Windows and Linux, satisfies offline constraint with least code.
Chunks of 10 finish fast enough that polling is sufficient; avoids websocket state and reconnect logic.

alternatives: ML/NLP model or LLM for experience parsing
decisions.decision: Regex date-range heuristic for experience plus normalized fuzzy keyword match with small alias map, in-memory run state
decisions.rationale: Offline, deterministic, explainable, no model download; in-memory state is enough for single-user local runs. ponytail: skip DB, skip ML.

decisions.decision: Single-sheet xlsx via openpyxl with summary rows on top then header plus per-resume rows
decisions.rationale: PRD mandates single .xlsx sheet layout; openpyxl is pure-python offline.

decisions.decision: jdatetime Jalali YYYY-MM-DD folder name with -1/-2 collision suffix
decisions.rationale: PRD requires Persian/Jalali date in folder name; pure-python jdatetime works offline on both OSes.

deployment.strategy: Single local process: pip install then uvicorn serve, backend reads server-local filesystem, no containers or cloud.

openQuestions: Results screen: full per-resume table in UI or summary counts only (wireframe leaves both options; architecture supports both since GET run returns full rows).
Screening date display: Jalali only or Jalali plus Gregorian side by side (report stores both, UI can show either).

risks.description: Scanned-image or password-protected PDFs yield no text; counted as Undetermined per AC-008 but high volume degrades perceived accuracy.
risks.mitigation: Detect empty-text extraction early, mark Undetermined with could-not-analyze reason without halting run; document no-OCR limit in UI.

risks.description: Experience heuristic mis-estimates on unusual date formats or Persian dates.
risks.mitigation: Conservative estimator returns Unknown instead of guessing; reason text states could not be determined; unit tests cover common resume date patterns.

risks.description: Large folders exhaust memory if all texts held at once.
risks.mitigation: Process strictly in chunks of 10, stream file reads, keep only ResumeResult structs in memory.

risks.description: Filename collisions or unicode names fail on copy to output folder.
risks.mitigation: Copy with shutil.copy2 preserving bytes, skip-and-record on OS error rather than aborting run.

tasks.objective: Scaffold FastAPI backend serving static frontend plus health endpoint
tasks.scope: Create backend package layout, requirements (fastapi, uvicorn, pypdf, python-docx, openpyxl, jdatetime), main.py with static mount and health route.
tasks.verification: pip install -r backend/requirements.txt then uvicorn backend.app.main:app; curl /api/health returns 200

tasks.definitionOfDone: POST scan on fixture folder returns only top-level pdf/docx count; zero-file folder returns 422 with no output side effect; run state machine supports start/status/pause/resume/cancel with chunk size 10
tasks.objective: Folder scan plus chunked run lifecycle API
tasks.scope: routes_runs.py endpoints plus runner.py in-memory registry with chunk queue, pause/resume/cancel flags, progress counters. No parsing logic here.
tasks.verification: pytest backend tests for scan filtering, empty-folder 422, pause/resume/cancel transitions

tasks.definitionOfDone: Extractor returns text for text-based PDF and DOCX fixtures, empty string for scanned/protected without raising; normalizer handles case/spacing/punctuation variants and React.js alias
tasks.objective: PDF/DOCX text extraction plus experience estimator and keyword matcher
tasks.scope: extraction.py only: pypdf text extract, python-docx paragraphs, date-range regex estimator returning float or None, fuzzy keyword match, candidate-name guess. No API or Excel code.
tasks.verification: pytest with sample pdf/docx fixtures including react variants and corrupt file

tasks.definitionOfDone: Evaluator implements AND over active criteria; 7yr passes 5yr bar, 3yr fails, unknown maps to Undetermined with explanatory reason; every result carries reason string
tasks.objective: Three-way qualification engine with pluggable criteria
tasks.scope: qualification.py only: Criterion protocol plus minYears and keywords evaluators, combine function emitting final status and reason. Imports fact types from extraction via local dataclass to avoid file overlap.
tasks.verification: pytest matrix: pass/fail/unknown experience crossed with found/missing keywords

tasks.definitionOfDone: Run on fixture folder creates Jalali-dated folder with -1/-2 suffix on collision, copies only Qualified files byte-identical, writes single-sheet xlsx with summary block plus all per-resume rows
tasks.objective: Jalali output folder plus qualified copy plus Excel report
tasks.scope: output_writer.py (folder naming via jdatetime, collision suffix, shutil.copy2) and report.py (openpyxl single sheet). Called by runner at finish/cancel.
tasks.verification: pytest end-to-end on temp dir: check folder name regex, collision suffix, originals untouched, xlsx summary and row counts

tasks.definitionOfDone: Setup screen renders folder input with scan count, min-years number input, keyword chip input with add/remove and duplicate rejection, start blocked until valid folder plus one criterion with hint text
tasks.scope: index.html structure for all three screens and styles.css responsive plus accessible states. No JS behavior here.
tasks.verification: Open index.html via served backend, check layout under 720px, axe or manual label/role checks

tasks.definitionOfDone: Progress screen polls GET run every 2s, updates bar and counters, pause/resume and cancel with confirm work against API, unreadable files never halt UI
tasks.scope: app_setup.js and app_progress.js: folder scan calls, criteria state, start gating, polling loop, pause/resume/cancel handlers. Exposes window.App hooks consumed by results module.
tasks.verification: Manual run against stub API plus JS unit check of chunk progress math

tasks.definitionOfDone: Results screen shows summary cards, output path with copy button, criteria recap, filterable per-resume table with reason column, new-run resets without refetch
tasks.objective: Results summary plus per-resume table behavior
tasks.scope: app_results.js only: render summary counts, output path, status filter chips plus search, table expand for long skills. No changes to setup/progress files.
tasks.verification: Manual run with stubbed GET run payload covering Qualified/Not Qualified/Undetermined rows and filter/search

techStack.rationale: Single local process satisfies offline Windows/Linux runs, mature PDF/DOCX/Excel/Jalali libraries, plain static frontend avoids build toolchain. No DB or auth needed for single-user local v1.
